title: Functional group effects on the electrocatalytic activity of iron phthalocyanine for the ORR, OER, and HER in an aqueous medium: insights from density functional theory
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, 10,3061-3074
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00140H, Paper
Angappan Kausalya, Senthilkumar Lakshmipathi
Density functional theory (DFT) calculations show that FePc functionalized with COOH groups, FePc(COOH)8, exhibits the best catalytic performance, with the lowest overpotentials for the ORR (1.16 V) and HER (0.19 V) among the studied systems.
